set.body: Release-hardening follow-up for the completed surface-view epic. Audit test oracles against coordinate/orientation, clipping, compositing, picking, serialization, resource lifecycle, and CPU/native/GPU parity failure modes; add missing regression/metamorphic/adversarial coverage; run live JavaFX and Chrome visual QA on asymmetric bilateral and thresholded layered fixtures; archive deterministic evidence and rerun focused plus repository-wide gates. Closure requires a visible browser example with exact semantic receipt, screenshot inspection, zero console errors, JavaFX live matrix, JVM/JS parity, compileAll/testAll, and scoped diff hygiene.
set.title: Surface viewer adversarial test and visual-QA hardening
